description: This is a test class for the PersonService, containing unit tests for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, deleting person entities, and handling duplicate emails.

classes.name: PersonServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing PersonService functionalities including create, getById, list, update, delete, and duplicate email handling.

methods.name: create_and_getById_roundtrip
methods.description: Tests creating a person and then retrieving it by ID to verify the data consistency.

methods.name: list_is_paginated
methods.description: Tests that the list method supports pagination and returns the correct number of entities.

methods.name: update_changes_fields
methods.description: Tests updating a person's details and verifying the changes.

methods.name: delete_removes_entity
methods.description: Tests deleting a person and ensuring subsequent retrieval throws a not found exception.

methods.name: create_duplicate_email_returns_conflict_error_code
methods.description: Tests that creating a person with a duplicate email results in an email conflict error.
